units.id: phrase:free worlds scanner payment|A Free Worlds captain is waiting for you when you land and takes a copy of your scanner logs, and you collect your payment of <payment>.|16|0

units.english: Scouting Run
units.italian: Ricognizione

units.english: Fly through the <waypoints> system and scout it out for Navy activity. Then return to <destination> by <date> where your ship's scanner logs will be analyzed. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Attraversa il sistema <waypoints> e esploralo in cerca di attività della Marina. Poi torna su <destination> entro il <date>, dove i registri del tuo scanner saranno analizzati. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you have yet to scout out all the marked systems. Visit all the systems marked on your map before returning.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora esplorato tutti i sistemi segnati. Visita tutti i sistemi indicati sulla tua mappa prima di tornare.

units.english: Convoy to <planet>

units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part or all of the convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
